title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Faded risk-on, hardware bid, oil up. Iran headlines flipped crude higher, feeding Fed-hike fears into 52% September odds, dragging megacap tech while small caps held. The tape split: AI hardware strength vs broad index drift lower, a high-low churn.

INDICES — VIX 15.3, down from 17.0 20d MA. SOXX +0.91%, IWM +0.34%, DIA -0.32%, SPY -0.32%, QQQ -0.34%. Small > large by 0.66pp. USO +1.34%; GLD -0.39%. SPY below 200-day, QQQ below — CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME — SPY vol 0.7x, QQQ 0.7x, both declining. GLD 1.0x and RSP 0.9x gaining. Vol down + price down = low-conviction drift; XLY 0.5x, XLC 0.6x ignored.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE +1.25%, XLU +1.16%, XLI +0.60%, XLB +0.11%, XLF -0.02%, XLK -0.12%, XLV -0.26%, XLP -0.31%, XLY -0.36%, XLC -0.50%, XLRE -0.72%. Top: MSOS +5.23%, DRAM +2.60%. Bottom: FXI -2.27%, KWEB -3.54%. Money into energy/defensives, out of REITs/comms. Label: narrow mega-cap tape.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 1.93 extreme protection; SPY 1.05 elevated. Skew positive both, fear bid. VIX below 20d MA, complacency. IWM GEX flip 305 vs spot, dealer hedging amplifies.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +1.34% vs equity index drift lower, inflation transmission. Gold -0.39% despite rate-hike fears; bonds bid TLT +0.16%.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 63.6. HON -5.27% on Q2 outlook cut; VRT +4.34% and KLAC +4.01%. SMCI vol spike, AI accumulation. Watch: MSOS +5.23% vol 1.4x, momentum break; XLRE -0.72% volume 1.2x, distribution.
